query:
SELECT id, title, category, isActive, 
  CASE WHEN beforeImage LIKE '%cloudfront%' AND LENGTH(beforeImage) > 100 THEN 'CDN' 
       WHEN beforeImage LIKE '%manuscdn%' THEN 'manuscdn' 
       WHEN beforeImage LIKE '/manus-storage%' THEN 'local'
       WHEN beforeImage = '' OR beforeImage IS NULL THEN 'EMPTY'
       ELSE 'other' END as imgType
FROM gallery_items WHERE isActive = 1 ORDER BY category, id;
